title: Explicit deferred-record and split-branch schedule-state preflight

scope.jing_ilp: Retain unresolved defects and apply the source Algorithm-1 bounding-cube age gate.
scope.lyons_brown: Reverse the latest decoder-side measurement to propagate deferred detector events; track abstract D(S3), D(Z3), and boundary states plus externally supplied neutrality.
not_in_scope: inference of neutrality from physical measurements
D4 or D(S3) noisy physical channel
schedule performance, threshold, or fault tolerance

invariants: schedule time is monotone and no cluster arrives from the future
Jing and Lyons-Brown branches have distinct event semantics
Jing deferral retains unresolved state without altering the measurement record
Lyons-Brown deferral reverses only current detector-bearing readouts
a deferred current detector reappears in the next round when the raw readout persists
D(S3) and boundary clusters ungauge before neutrality can be supplied
age in D(Z3) is measured relative to the ungauging boundary
neutral D(Z3) clusters correct and re-gauge; non-neutral clusters remain deferred
no truth, future record, or physical noisy D4 adapter is consumed

verified_cases: detector event moves from the current transition to the next after readout reversal
past and absent-event propagation is rejected
Jing branch retains then commits without record mutation
Lyons-Brown D(S3) branch defers, ungauges, waits relative to the boundary, then corrects/re-gauges on neutral outcome
boundary branch ungauges and non-neutral D(Z3) outcome remains deferred
future registration and missing current decoder record are rejected

claim_boundary: The implementation verifies abstract causal state transitions only. Absorber distances and neutrality are supplied inputs; no microscopic D(S3) operation, D4 noise channel, schedule performance, threshold, or fault tolerance is established.
next_gate: Implement the smallest explicit absorber-geometry and neutrality-measurement interfaces on deterministic D(S3)-labelled fixtures, including linked-cluster restrictions, before any noisy D4 channel.
